name: Drake’s Heart
body:
Price 1,000 gp; Aura strong conjuration; CL 15th; Slot none; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This fist sized gem shines with a dull spark inside of it and must be attuned to a drake with a charge over the course of 1 week. If the attuned drake dies, its charge can touch the drake’s heart and take 1 point of damage per level they possess to imbue it with their life energy. After 1 week, the attuned drake is brought back to life, shattering the drake’s heart.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells raise dead; Cost 500 gp
